name: Granola MCP
description: Search your Granola meeting notes and transcripts from Claude, ChatGPT, or Claude Code to find past discussions, action items, and decisions. For Granola users.

skills.name: Chat With Your Meetings
skills.description: Answers questions about your meeting history by chatting with Granola across the meeting notes your account can access.

skills.name: List Meetings
skills.description: Lists the meeting notes you can access with meeting ID, title, date, and attendees, and filters by folder on paid plans.

skills.name: Read Meeting Notes
skills.description: Reads meeting notes with attendees, private notes, and summarized notes, so an agent can pull out action items and decisions.

skills.name: Meeting Transcripts
skills.description: Retrieves the raw transcript of a meeting so the agent can give specific quotes of what was said; paid plans only.

skills.name: Shared-Screen Screenshots
skills.description: Views screenshots of screens shared during a meeting, such as slides, charts, or code, to answer questions about them.
